content.short: Joule Finance is a liquidity hub and money market on Aptos and Movement focusing on high LRT composability.
content.description: Joule Finance is a specialized decentralized money market and liquidity hub built natively for the Aptos and Movement blockchain ecosystems. The protocol focuses on enhancing the composability of Liquid Restaking Tokens (LRTs), allowing users to bridge and borrow against major assets across different networks. This provides increased capital efficiency and a wider range of yield-bearing opportunities within a single interface. By leveraging Move-based blockchains, Joule Finance provides professional-grade risk management and seamless interoperability for decentralized asset growth.
